resources.string: Switch between eSIM and physical SIM 2
eSIM and physical SIM 2 share a connection. Enabling eSIM disconnects physical SIM 2. Physical SIM 1 stays available.
Modem slot information is unavailable. Refresh after the radio is ready.
The modem did not confirm the switch. Refresh status before trying again.
Disable the active eSIM in “Add or manage eSIMs” before switching to physical SIM 2.
